body:
A quand

title: SWIPE OPTION
body:
It would make the app so much more satisfying and responsive if the swipe option that apple puts in every app would be implemented. 

It happens way too often that I try to swipe left and go back to the overview and realize it isn't a feature. You can only go back using the < button in the top left corner which is very unpleasant if one is accustomed to apples default swipe to go back option.

title: Not even the basics
body:
Doesn't even allow you to format text bold or with different font sizes. Does not allow you to add bullet points. When adding tick boxes, they are added to every single line in the note.

Useless even for the most basic list.

author: Lochi1893

title: Sehr gut
body:
Finde das Programm sehr gut: die hier zum Teil negativen Bewertungen kann ich überhaupt nicht nachvollziehen.
Als relativ simples aber trotzdem ziemlich leistungsstarkes Notiz-Tool, das doch über einige beachtliche Features verfügt, gehört es zu meinen täglich benutzten Apps, und dies obwohl ich auch eine Abo-App für 
noch etwas strukturiertere Notizen habe.
Google hat ganz zweifellos die eine oder andere "schwache" App im Programm,
aber Google Notes ist sehr gut. Merci an die Entwickler 👍😀

title: Good integration with gSuite, features like word formatting on rather low end of spectrum
body:
Online availability etc. is quite good.
Wide range of features available however on rather low end of maturity, e.g. the rather non-existing word formatting and also the accuracy of the drawing function. For the latter - writing notes by hand is challenging when trying to read later - gives you sometimes a feeling of an archaeologist deciphering cuneiform writing...

Hope that Google invests a bit more here - otherwise I am quite happy with it!
